title: Carex Classics Dual-Button Walker
purpose: Tell Carex that Mum, Rosa, weighs 280 lb and had a hip replacement last week. Dana wrote that the walker must hold 300 lb, and our bathroom door is 28 inches. Ask if they can get it here sooner and what a return costs.

questions: Can the walker be delivered by December 2, 2026?
What is the cost of a return?
